T he City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Library
Board of Trustees with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 4th Monday of every month at 8:00 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the Community Services Department via email at
KShigenaga@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at (626) 300­0791 at least 48 hours prior to
the meeting.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do its best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Library Board of
Trustees on any item of interest that is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Board of
Trustees. Pursuant to state law, the Library Board of Trustees may not discuss or take
action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Chair
reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up
on such items.

minutes_text:
MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, NOVEMBER 27, 2023 AT 8:00 A.M.
  BARTH ROOM, CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY

CALL TO ORDER: Chairperson Domier called the regular meeting to order at 8:02 a.m. in the
Barth Room, located at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Chairperson Domier led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Trustee Chien (arrived at 8:06 a.m.), Trustee Derry, Trustee
  Osegueda, Vice Chairperson Sadun, Chairperson Domier

  ABSENT: Alternate Wahl, Alternate Wu

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS

1. CHAIRPERSON REPORT

Chairperson Domier shared that this is the last Board meeting of the year, reminded the Board of
the duties of good members, encouraged the Board to talk to others in the community to promote
the Library and seek their feedback, and encouraged the Board to attend programs at the Library.

2. TRUSTEE REPORTS

Vice Chairperson Sadun shared that Sandy Morris’ celebration of life was so well attended. She
added that Sandy made such an impact on so many lives because of how strongly she felt about the
importance of libraries and reading to the community.

Trustee Chien, Trustee Derry, and Trustee Osegueda did not have anything to report.

3. CRAIN ART GALLERY LIAISON REPORT

Vice Chairperson Sadun shared that 45 people attended the opening reception for Emily Suñez, at
which Emily sold several of her paintings. She shared that the next exhibit runs from December 28
to February 16 with a reception on February 3 featuring Chinese flower arranging, followed by a
display by the San Marino Public Library Foundation from February 24 to March 29.
 LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
NOVEMBER 27, 2023  PAGE 2 OF 3

4. FRIENDS OF THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Derry shared that the last two meetings were cancelled, so she has nothing to report.

5. SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Chien shared that the bookmark contest started on November 13 and runs until December
15, and has a theme of “Something Wild in San Marino.” She shared that Delicious Destinations is
occurring on March 16 and Cindy has spoken to American author Michael Connelly in hopes of
having him as a guest speaker. She also shared that the Friends, Foundation, and Board will be having
a joint meeting.

NEW BUSINESS

6. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Trustee Osegueda moved, seconded by Trustee Chien, to approve the minutes of the regular
meeting of October 23, 2023.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Trustee Chien, Trustee Derry, Trustee Osegueda, Vice Chairperson Sadun,
  Chairperson Domier
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Alternate Wahl, Alternate Wu

7. DIRECTOR AND LIBRARY MANAGER REPORT

Director Johnson and Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

8. CALIFORNIA STATE LIBRARY REPORT

Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Trustee Osegueda moved, seconded by Vice Chairperson Sadun, to receive and file the fiscal year
2022-23 California State Library Report and recommend it for ratification by the City Council.
